original_question: Bere a Elvira dii mfeɛ 30 no, ɔfaa abɛɛfo badwemma afidie foforo a na nneɛma pii wɔmu sɛ akyɛde maa no. Ɔwɔ sika a ne fiefoɔ nyinaa de ma no a ne dodoɔ yɛ €1500 na ɔsusu sɛ ɔbɛtumi di sika kakra atɔ ntama no. Ɔkɔ abɛɛfo badwemma afidie  dwumadibea kɔfaa afidie noa na ne boɔ yɛ €1090 a ɛyɛ ahwehwɛ, keyboard ne mouse womu. Afei nso ɔfa scanner a na ne boɔ yɛ €157, CD burner a na ne boɔ yɛ €74 ne printer a na ne boɔ yɛ €102. Sika ahe na obenya de atɔ n'atade no?
